purpose: Hero product render — 3/4 elevated view showing the organic pebble form, screen with breathing light ring, fabric mesh zone, and warm ceramic material of the elderly AI companion device
prompt:
Product hero render of an AI companion device for elderly users, 3/4 view slightly elevated angle.

The device is a palm-sized organic pebble-shaped object, height-to-width ratio approximately 1:1.3. Smooth continuous curves, absolutely no sharp edges or corners. Inspired by a naturally river-worn pebble.

Body: warm ceramic white matte finish (#F2EDE8), subtle fine-grain texture like unglazed porcelain. The surface gently catches light with soft gradients.

Screen: horizontal elliptical display in the upper 1/3 of the device, showing large Chinese text "今天天气很好 ☀" in dark warm gray (#5C5650) on soft blue-white (#B8D4E3) background. Frosted glass finish, anti-glare.

Breathing light: a soft amber (#E8C9A0) glowing ring surrounds the screen, 2-3mm wide, embedded at the boundary between screen and body. Gentle warm glow, the only light-emitting element. Creates a sense of life and companionship.

Fabric mesh: the lower half of the device is wrapped in woven fabric mesh in fabric-mist gray (#C8C3BC), fine textile texture, speaker grille. Seamlessly transitions from ceramic body.

Base: soft-touch silicone in soft-stone gray (#D4CFC9), flat bottom with anti-slip pad.

Lighting: soft natural light from 45° upper left, warm color temperature 5200K. Gentle contact shadow on clean matte cloud white (#E8E4DF) surface. No harsh reflections.

Style: photorealistic industrial design render, Muji product photography aesthetic. Warm, approachable, dignified. Like a home decor object, not technology.
negative_prompt: ElliQ two-part head+body, LED expression face, cylindrical shape, perfect sphere, Amazon Echo, Google Nest, sharp edges, pure black, cold white, high saturation, medical device, cyberpunk, glowing nodes, hex patterns, random gradients, glossy metallic, chrome, small text, complex UI
